verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
I'm coming back to the start
Where You found me

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
I'm coming back to Your heart
Now I surrender

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
Take me
This is all I can bring

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
You'll never stop loving us
No matter how far we run

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
You'll never give up on us
All of heaven shouts: let the future begin
Let the future begin

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
I'm coming back to the start
Our God is freedom

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
And here we feel Your heart
Your heart beat for us

verse.name: v2c
verse.lines:
Take me
This is all I can bring

verse.name: p1
verse.lines:
Take me
This is all I can bring

verse.name: c2
verse.lines:
I feel alive, I come alive
I am alive on God's great dance floor

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
Oh oh...
Oh oh oh oh oh its always a good time
